content: So I've been thinking about the API restructure we discussed yesterday.
Right, the one where we split the monolithic handler into domain-specific modules. Have you decided on the folder structure?

Yeah, going with /src/handlers/ for now. Can you create two files for me:

1. In /src/handlers/users.go put a basic handler struct with a placeholder comment saying "// TODO: implement user CRUD"

2. In /src/handlers/orders.go do the same thing but for orders - just the struct and a "// TODO: implement order management" comment

Nothing fancy, just getting the scaffolding in place.
